[[File:Mechnochair.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] communicate using a holotransceiver]]
A '''holotransmitter''' or '''holotransceiver''' was a device to intercept and play holographic messages, and retain contact between two or more beings over long distances. Such a device was integrated into [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]].

In [[3951 BBY]], [[Skirmish at Peragus II|trapped]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] at the [[Peragus Mining Facility]], modified a holo-transmitter into a crude relay that beamed short-burst transmissions, in the form of a [[Military flash code]], outside of the mining facility. However, the signal strength was weak and the miners reasoned that even if the signal carried beyond the [[Peragus asteroid field|asteroid field]] surrounding the facility, any potential rescuers would have needed to have been scouring the frequencies to detect the signal.
